gloss: such; that kind of; like that

definitions.gloss: such; that kind of; of that sort
definitions.explanation: Modifies a following noun to point back at something just mentioned or known to the listener. The formal written counterpart of そんな, standard in business letters, official notices, and careful speech.

examples.japanese: そのような⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us in such a case.

examples.japanese: そのような⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have never heard such a thing.

examples.japanese: そのような⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{起|お}こらない→起こる：01910_okoru⟧よう、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}します→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: We will review our safety measures so that such an accident never happens again.

notes:
USAGE:
Always followed by a noun. Before a verb or adjective the adverbial form そのように is used instead: そのように⟦{考|かんが}えています→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (I think along those lines).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- そのような⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: in such a case
- そのようなこと: such a thing
- そのような⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: a person of that sort (polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧: such, that kind of — the everyday spoken equivalent; そのような is one register higher
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ような: this kind of — for things near the speaker or just introduced by the speaker
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧ような: that kind of — for things distant from both speaker and listener
